longest_story.synopsis: The X-Men try to find their missing teammates who vanished in battle with Legion. Legion and the missing X-Men are twenty years in the past with Magneto and Xavier in Israel. Lilandra warns Xavier that Legion's actions in the past may disrupt all of reality. Meanwhile... back at the mansion, Sabretooth breaks out of his holding cell and is confronted by Wolverine.
